description: Make an earlier published version of a page live again for everyone, right away. The version that was live stays in the history and can be restored back. Confirm with the user first. Pass expectedCurrentId (the live version from list_versions) so a page that changed in the meantime is not overwritten.

deploymentId.description: The version to make live, from list_versions.

expectedCurrentId.description: Optional: the version you saw as live. A page changed since then is refused.

siteId.description: Page id (siteId) returned by a publish tool or list_pages.

name: restore_version

deploymentId.description: The version that is live now.

restored.description: true when the version was made live.

title: Restore version
